title: Puech's forbidden-subgraph conjecture for irredundance perfect graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a graph, and let $P_6$, $G_4$, and $G_5$ be the graphs described in Figure 5 of the source. **Puech's conjecture.** If $G$ does not contain $P_6$, $G_4$, or $G_5$ as induced subgraphs, then $G$ is irredundance perfect. The supplied text introduces this as a generalization of the preceding conjectures but gives no resolution of it, so its status remains open.
source_name: Vadim Zverovich, Pavel Skums and Lutz Volkmann, “A Characterization of P_6-Free Irredundance Perfect Graphs”, arXiv:2603.14668 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14668

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2026).
